L58@P3: See the attachment (Fig. 1).
L59@P3: 5.0. Appearance
L60@P3: There shall be no such defects as rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely affect
L61@P3: commercial value of the cell.
L62@P3: 6.0. Standard Test Condition
L63@P3: 6.1 Environment Condition
L64@P3:  Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at
L65@P3: temperature 25±2°C and humidity under 65% RH.
L66@P3: 6.2 Measuring Equipment
L67@P3: (1) Amp-meter and volt-meter
L68@P3: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.50mA and
L69@P3: 0.50mV or higher.
L70@P3: (2) Slide caliper
L71@P3: The slide caliper should have 0.01mm scale.
L72@P3: (3) Impedance meter
L73@P3: The impedance meter with AC 1kHz should be used.
L74@P3: 7.0. Characteristics
L75@P3: 7.1 Standard Charge
L76@P3: Standard Charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 2.0A, constant
L77@P3: voltage 4.20V and 100mA cut-off in CV mode at 25°C for capacity.
L78@P3: 7.2 Rapid Charge
L79@P3: Rapid Charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 6.0A, constant voltage
L80@P3: 4.20V and 100mA cut-off in CV mode at 25°C.
L81@P3: 7.3 Standard Discharge Capacity
L82@P3: The Standard Discharge Capacity is the initial discharge capacity of the cell, which is
L83@P3: measured with discharge current of 0.80A with 2.50V cut-off at 25°C within 1 hour after
L84@P3-4: the standard charge. -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A

L90@P4: Initial Internal Impedance ≤ 13mΩ

L130@P5: 7.9 Status of the cell as of ex-factory
L131@P5: The cell should be shipped in 3.400V to 3.550V charging voltage range.
L132@P5: 8.0. Mechanical Characteristics
L133@P5: 8.1 Drop test
L134@P5:  Test method: Each fully charged cell is dropped three times from a height of 1.0m onto a
L135@P5: concrete floorat 20±5°C. The cells are dropped so as to obtain impacts in
L136@P5: random orientations. After the test, the cells shall be put on rest for a
L137@P5: minimum one hour and then a visual inspection shall be performed.
L138@P5:  Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L139@P5:  Drop test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard.
L140@P5: 8.2 Vibration test
L141@P5: Test method: For X and Y axis with cylindrical cell 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min, repetition
L142@P5: 12times totally 3hours, the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz,then amplitude
L143@P5-6: 1.6mm and maximum 8g up to 200Hz. Tests are to be conducted at 20±5°C.-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A
L144@P6: 5 / 11
L145@P6:  Criteria: No fire, no explosion, no leakage, with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L146@P6: Vibration test shall be performed with the UN38.3 standard.
L147@P6: 9.0. Safety
L148@P6: 9.1 Overcharge test
L149@P6: Test method: Fully standard discharged cell is charged with 8.2A to 7.5V or until charging
L150@P6: time up to 7h.
L151@P6: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L152@P6: 9.2 External Short-circuit test
L153@P6: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the
L154@P6: positive and negative terminals of the cell with a circuit load having
L155@P6: aresistance load of 80±20mΩ. Until the test time is lasting to 10min.
L156@P6: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L157@P6: External short-circuit test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard.
L158@P6: 9.3 Forced Discharge test
L159@P6: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 4.0A(1C) for 90min at
L160@P6: 20±5°C.
L161@P6: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L162@P6: Forced discharge test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard.
L163@P6: 9.4 Heating test
L164@P6: Test method: To heat up the standard charged cell at heating rate 5°C per minute up to
L165@P6: 130°C and keep the cell in oven for 10 minutes.
L166@P6: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L167@P6: Heating test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard.
L168@P6: 9.5 Low Pressure test
L169@P6: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be stored at a pressure of 11.6 kPa or less
L170@P6: for at least six hoursat ambient temperature.
L171@P6: Criteria: No fire, no explosion and no leakage with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L172@P6: Low pressure test shall be performed with the UN38.3 standard.
L173@P6: 10.0. Warranty
L174@P6-7: The warranty period of cellsare made according to business contract. However, even -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A

L176@P7: though the problem occurs within this period, EVE won’t replace a new cell for free as
L177@P7: long as the problem is not due to the failure of EVE manufacturing process or is due to
L178@P7: customer’s abuse or misuse.
L179@P7: EVE will not be responsible for trouble occurred by handling outside of the precautions in
L180@P7: instructions.
L181@P7: EVE will not be responsible for trouble occurred by matching electric circuit, cell pack and
L182@P7: charger.
L183@P7: EVE will be exempt from warrantee any defect cells during assembling after acceptance.
L184@P7: 11.0. Precautions and Safety Instructions
L185@P7: Lithium-ion rechargeable cells subject to abusive conditions can cause damage to the cell
L186@P7: and/or personal injury. Please read and observe the standard cell precautions below
L187@P7: beforeusing utilization.
L188@P7: Note 1. The customer is required to contact EVE in advance, if the customer needs other
L189@P7: applications or operating conditions than those described in this document.
L190@P7: Note 2. EVE will take no responsibility for any accident when the cell is used under other
L191@P7: conditions than those described in this document.
L192@P7: Note 3.For the sake of safety assurance, please discuss the equipment design, its system
L193@P7: and protection circuit of Lithium-ion cell with EVE in advance. And consult about the high
L194@P7: rate current, rapid charge and special application in the same way.
L195@P7: 12.0. Guide for the use of Lithium-ion cells
L196@P7: 12.1 General
L197@P7:  This chapter has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions,
L198@P7: which the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the
L199@P7: lithium ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by EVE Energy CO., LTD., in order to
L200@P7: obtain optimal performance and safety.
L201@P7: 12.2 Charging
L202@P7: 12.2.1 Charging current
L203@P7:  Charging current shall be less than maximum charge current specified in the
L204@P7: specification.
L205@P7: 12.2.2 Charging voltage
L206@P7: Charging shall be done by voltage less than that specified in the specification.
L207@P7-8: 12.2.3 Charging temperature-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A
L208@P8: 7 / 11
L209@P8:  The cell shall be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L210@P8: 12.2.4 Reverse charging
L211@P8:  The cell shall be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse
L212@P8: charging shall be strictly prohibited. If the cell is connected improperly, it may be
L213@P8: damaged.
L214@P8: 12.3 Discharging
L215@P8: 12.3.1 Discharging current
L216@P8: The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharging current
L217@P8: specified in the specification. In case of the higher discharging current should be set, it
L218@P8: shall be discussed with EVE.
L219@P8: 12.3.2 Discharging temperature
L220@P8: The cell shall be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the
L221@P8: specification. Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics.
L222@P8: 12.3.3 Over-discharging
L223@P8:  The system should equip with a device to prevent further discharging exceeding
L224@P8: discharging cut-off voltage specified in the specification.
L225@P8:  Over-discharging may cause loss of performance characteristics of cell.
L226@P8: Over-discharging may occur by self-discharging if the cell is left for a very long time
L227@P8: without any use.
L228@P8:  The charger should equip with a device to detect voltage of cell box and to determine
L229@P8: recharging procedures.
L230@P8: 12.4 Storage
L231@P8: 12.4.1 Storage conditions
L232@P8:  The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified in the specification.
L233@P8: Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L234@P8: 12.4.2 Long term storage
L235@P8: The cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term storage
L236@P8: may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging. If long-term storage is necessary, the
L237@P8: cell should be stored at lower voltage within a range specified in the specification,
L238@P8: because storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of performance
L239@P8: characteristics.
L240@P8: 12.5 Cycle life
L241@P8-9: 12.5.1 The cell can be charged & discharged repeatedly up to times with a certain level of -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A
L242@P9: 8 / 11
L243@P9: capacity specified in specification.
L244@P9: 12.5.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L245@P9: temperature and/or storage.
L246@P9: 12.6 Design of system
L247@P9: 12.6.1 Connection between the cell and the battery
L248@P9: The cell should not be soldered directly with other cells. Namely, the cell should be
L249@P9: welded with leads on its terminal and then be soldered with wire or leads to solder.
L250@P9: Otherwise, it may cause damage of component, such as separator and insulator, by
L251@P9: heat generation.
L252@P9: 12.6.2 Positioning the battery in the system
L253@P9: The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources and high
L254@P9: temperature components. Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics. The
L255@P9: recommended spacing between the cells is more than 1mm.
L256@P9: 12.6.3 Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L257@P9: The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack in order
L258@P9: to minimize shock, which can damage the cells. Otherwise, it may cause shape
L259@P9: distortion, leakage, heat generation and/or rupture and/or open circuit.
L260@P9: 12.6.4 Short-circuit protection of the cell
L261@P9: The cell equips with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which may occur
L262@P9: during transportation, battery assembly and/or system operation. If the cell sleeve is
L263@P9: damaged by some cause such as outside impact, it may cause short-circuit with some
L264@P9: wiring inside the battery.
L265@P9: 12.6.5 Connection between the battery and charger/system
L266@P9: The battery should be designed to be connected only to the specified charger and
L267@P9: system. A reverse connection of the battery, even in the specified system, should be
L268@P9: avoided by employing special battery design such as a special terminal.
L269@P9: 12.6.6 Pack design
L270@P9: The current consumption of the battery pack should be under 10uA at sleep mode.
L271@P9: The system should be equipped with a device to monitor each voltage of cell block to
L272@P9: avoid cell imbalance which can cause damage to the cells.
L273@P9: The battery pack or system should have warning system such as over temperature,
L274@P9: over voltage, over current, and so on.
L275@P9-10: 12.7 Battery pack assembly-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A
L276@P10: 9 / 11
L277@P10: 12.7.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L278@P10: The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly. The cell should not be
L279@P10: used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or electrolyte-smell is detected.
L280@P10: 12.7.2 Terminals handing
L281@P10: Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip
L282@P10: terminal is welled.
L283@P10: 12.7.3 Transportation
L284@P10: If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer, careful
L285@P10: precautions should be taken to avoid damage of cell.
L286@P10: 12.8 Others
L287@P10: 12.8.1 Disassembly
L288@P10: The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L289@P10: Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or
L290@P10: venting.
L291@P10: When the electrolyte with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L292@P10: 12.8.2 Short-circuiting
L293@P10: Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L294@P10: An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L295@P10: 12.8.3 Incineration
L296@P10: Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may cause
L297@P10: rupture and explosion.
L298@P10: 12.8.4 Immersion
L299@P10: Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and
L300@P10: leakage of components to be damaged to functions.
L301@P10: 12.8.5 Mixing use
L302@P10: Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer shall not be used,
L303@P10: which may lead to cell imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due to the different
L304@P10: characteristics of cell.
L305@P10: 12.8.6 Battery exchange
L306@P10:  Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as lead or
L307@P10: cadmium, the battery shall be disposed according to the local regulations when it is
L308@P10: disposed.
L309@P10-11: The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by an -EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/40P Spec. No. RD-EVE INR21700/40P-S113-LF Version No. A
L310@P11: 10 / 11
L311@P11: inadvertent short-circuit.
L312@P11: 12.8.7 Caution
L313@P11: The battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if mistreated.
L314@P11: Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100°C or incinerate it.
L315@P11: Do not expose the cell to extreme heat or flame.
L316@P11: Do not short circuit, over-charge or over-discharge the cell.
L317@P11: Do not subject the cell to strong mechanical shocks.
L318@P11: Do not immerse the cell in water or sea water, or get it wet.
L319@P11: Do not reverse the polarity of the cell for any reason.
L320@P11: Do not disassemble or modify the cell.
L321@P11: Do not handle or store with metallic like necklaces, coins or hairpins, etc.
L322@P11: Do not use the cell with conspicuous damage or deformation.
L323@P11: Do not connect cell to the plug socket or car-cigarette-plug.
L324@P11: Do not make the direct soldering onto a cell.
L325@P11: Do not touch a leaked cell directly.
L326@P11: Do not use Lithium-ion cell in mixture.
L327@P11: Do not use or leave the cell under the blazing sun (or in heated car by sunshine).
L328@P11: Keep cell away from children.
L329@P11: Do not drive a nail into the cell, strike it by hammer or tread it.
L330@P11: Replace battery with those of EVE only.
L331@P11: 13.0. Others
L332@P11: 13.1 Storage for a long time
L333@P11: If the cell is stored for a long time (3 months or more), it is strongly recommended that the
L334@P11: cell is performed one cycle，the voltage of the cell is recommended from 3.50V to 3.80V,
L335@P11: the environment should be low-temperature (normally 0~25°C), dry and no corrosive gas.
L336@P11: 13.2 Others
L337@P11: Any matters not involved in this specifications, should be conferred with the both parties.
